title: Recursive NAND block embedding
statement: For each natural number $d$ and each $i\in\{0,1\}$, define an injective map from the coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}(2^d)$ into those in $\mathrm{Fin}(2^{d+1})$ by sending $j$ to the coordinate corresponding to the pair $(i,j)$ under the standard identification of $\mathrm{Fin}(2^{d+1})$ with $\mathrm{Fin}(2)\times\mathrm{Fin}(2^d)$.
